title: RC yacht hull
description: An International One Metre radio-sailing yacht to the IOM Class Rules 2026: a glass hull lofted from a table of stations with a painted deck, a tapered carbon fin, a lead bulb sized by its mass and a carbon rudder, floated at the class's 4 kg in fresh water.
process: Glass/epoxy hull and deck laid up in female moulds off a milled plug, carbon/epoxy fin and rudder moulded, lead bulb cast

difficulty.rationale: A lofted hull from a table of offsets with a faired bumper section, plated with joints, NACA sections from formulas, and a mass and hydrostatics budget coupled across seven bodies with class-rule knowledge.

standards: NACA four-digit sections (Abbott and von Doenhoff, eq. 6.2)
materials: Glass fibre and epoxy laminate, white gelcoat; deck painted grey-blue

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: bulb 2300.0007 g, waterline +0.50 mm, draft 415.5 mm, hull depth 54.50 mm, waterline length 994.4 mm, beam 157.8 mm, GM 201.5 mm, keel 2467.7 g, corrector 306.4 g; 14 checks pass; deck thicken refused at 8 mm (pole), interference of hull and bumper unknown (F-130); about 250 steps.
